item_name: Rothco Honor and Respect Thin Blue Line Low Profile Cap - Black
item_short_desc: Show your support for police and law enforcement officials with Rothco’s Honor and Respect Thin Blue Line Low Profile Cap.
description: Show your support for police and law enforcement officials with Rothco’s Honor and Respect Thin Blue Line Low Profile Cap. Honor & Respect Graphic Embroidered On Front Center And Thin Blue Line Flag Embroidered On Left Side.  Low Profile Cap is made from brushed cotton twill.  Fits most sizes with adjustable hook and loop closure.  Built in sweat band for perspiration. The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police & Law Enforcement Officials.  Proceeds from this purchase benefit families of fallen first responders.
